scenes.purpose: Introduce the concept of electric circuits and their components.
scenes.template_selection_reasoning: The title slide is essential for setting the stage for the lesson, providing a clear introduction to the topic of electric circuits.
scenes.teacher_script: In this lesson, we will explore the fundamentals of simple electric circuits, focusing on components like batteries, switches, resistors, and bulbs.

template_data.title: Understanding Simple Electric Circuits
template_data.subtitle: Exploring the flow of electric current

scenes.purpose: Explain the components of a simple electric circuit.
scenes.template_selection_reasoning: A concept diagram effectively illustrates the relationship between the main components of an electric circuit, allowing students to visualize how they connect and interact.
scenes.teacher_script: A simple electric circuit consists of four main components: a battery, a switch, a resistor, and a bulb. Each plays a crucial role in the flow of electric current.

template_data.title: Components of a Simple Electric Circuit

scenes.purpose: Demonstrate how current flows through the circuit.
scenes.template_selection_reasoning: An illustrated scene allows for a visual representation of the flow of current in a circuit, making it easier for students to understand the dynamic process involved.
scenes.teacher_script: When the switch is closed, the circuit is complete, allowing current to flow from the battery through the resistor and into the bulb, causing it to light up.

scenes.purpose: Summarize the key points about electric circuits.
scenes.template_selection_reasoning: A cycle template is suitable for summarizing the continuous process of current flow in an electric circuit, reinforcing the concept of how each component interacts.
scenes.teacher_script: In summary, a simple electric circuit consists of a battery, switch, resistor, and bulb. When the switch is closed, current flows, lighting the bulb.
